# Pinned Splunk dev toolchain for the DETERMINISTIC loop-smoke CI gate.
#
# Why pinned: loop-smoke proves the agentic loop reaches AppInspect-CLEAN with NO LLM,
# so its result must be reproducible. A ucc-gen / splunk-appinspect release can change
# generated files or check outcomes and flip the gate red on an unrelated day - so the
# version is pinned here and bumped deliberately.
#
# How updates flow: Dependabot (pip ecosystem, .github/dev-requirements.txt) opens a PR
# when a newer release ships; the loop-smoke job runs against the bump and must still
# reach CLEAN before the PR can merge. The other CI jobs (splunk-app, splunk-integration,
# licenses) intentionally float to the latest ucc-gen (>=) so they always compat-test the
# newest release on every run.
#
# Validated CLEAN locally on both the config-only and input-bearing fixtures at these pins.
splunk-add-on-ucc-framework==6.5.1
splunk-appinspect==4.2.1
